title: [CON2-17] Appendix D leaves out identifiers that the new text allocates
description: Review finding CON2-17: Appendix D leaves out identifiers that the new text allocates (lens CON2). Location: spec/99-appendices.md:117-149. Fix: Drop `AgoraProvisioning`: no such DID service type exists anywhere in spec/ (grep finds none; 02:415 is a revocation body). The rest holds: `_corundum._agora` (10:497) is missing from the `_agora` children row; WebSocket subprotocol `agora-sfu.v1` (06:108) needs a Web identifiers row with IANA "WebSocket Subprotocol Name Registry" (RFC 6455 §11.5); `serviceType` values `relay`, `sfu`, `sequencer`, `turn`, `push-proxy` (§10.5.1) go in the capability and model strings table. Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
